policy.description: lts: newest active LTS major only. active-latest: newest active major, LTS or Current.

packageType.description: application: engines.node targets one runtime. library: engines.node may span multiple active release lines.

includeAllActiveLts.description: For libraries, include every active LTS line in engines.node and CI, not just the newest.

includeCurrentForLibraries.description: For libraries, additionally include the active Current (non-LTS) release.
